<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="pm45UxFj0255i23yMmCj"> <mxGraphModel dx="1885" dy="-2245" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "graph TD
 %% Дефиниране на стилове за концептуален модел
 classDef entity fill:#2b2b2b,stroke:#5865F2,stroke-width:2px,rx:5,ry:5,color:#ffffff,font-weight:bold;
 classDef attribute fill:#383838,stroke:#b9bbbe,stroke-width:1px,color:#ffffff;
 classDef relationship fill:#2b2b2b,stroke:#eb459e,stroke-width:2px,shape:diamond,color:#ffffff,font-weight:bold;
 classDef container fill:none,stroke:none;

 %% Групиране на атрибути със същности (С премахнати ID-та)
 subgraph Users_Group [ ]
 U[USERS]:::entity
 U_a1((username)):::attribute
 U_a2((email)):::attribute
 U_a3((status)):::attribute
 U --- U_a1
 U --- U_a2
 U --- U_a3
 end
 class Users_Group container;

 subgraph Servers_Group [ ]
 S[SERVERS]:::entity
 S_a1((server_name)):::attribute
 S_a2((region)):::attribute
 S --- S_a1
 S --- S_a2
 end
 class Servers_Group container;

 subgraph Channels_Group [ ]
 C[CHANNELS]:::entity
 C_a1((channel_name)):::attribute
 C_a2((channel_type)):::attribute
 C --- C_a1
 C --- C_a2
 end
 class Channels_Group container;

 subgraph Roles_Group [ ]
 R[ROLES]:::entity
 R_a1((role_name)):::attribute
 R --- R_a1
 end
 class Roles_Group container;

 subgraph Messages_Group [ ]
 M[MESSAGES]:::entity
 M_a1((content)):::attribute
 M --- M_a1
 end
 class Messages_Group container;

 %% Връзки (Relationships - Ромбове без кардиналности)
 rel_owns{owns}:::relationship
 rel_has_roles{has_roles}:::relationship
 rel_sends{sends}:::relationship
 rel_contains{contains}:::relationship
 rel_defines{defines}:::relationship
 rel_hosts{hosts}:::relationship

 U --> rel_owns --> S
 U --> rel_has_roles --> R
 U --> rel_sends --> M
 S --> rel_contains --> C
 S --> rel_defines --> R
 C --> rel_hosts --> M",
